values.note: Electric sites $25, reserved or first come. Non-electric sites $20, but the county's maps mark them for small units and tents.

fees.source: https://www.polkcountyiowa.gov/conservation/things-to-do/camping/ ('Reservable rates are $25 for electric sites and $20 for non-electric. First-come, first-served camping rates are $25 for electric sites and $20 for non-electric.') + mycountyparks site 101 ('$25 /Night') + campground #5/#6 maps (legend 'NON-ELECTRIC SITES SMALL UNITS / TENTS'), read 2026-11-03

values.note: 78 electric sites (101-124 and 204-229 in campgrounds 1-2, 401-428 in campground 4), all drawn as back-in spurs. Not counted: 33 non-electric sites the maps mark for small units and tents (campgrounds 5 and 6), 21 tent-only hike-in sites, and the youth and group camps.

facilities.source: https://www.polkcountyiowa.gov/media/3wfjhq4u/jester_campground1-2_2025.pdf (legend and map: SHOWERS, DUMP STATION, WATER HYDRANT) + https://www.polkcountyiowa.gov/conservation/things-to-do/camping/ ('Campground showerhouses are open mid-April through mid-October'), read 2026-11-03

values.note: Walk-in tent camping is allowed year-round; showerhouses open mid-April to mid-October.

season.source: https://www.polkcountyiowa.gov/conservation/things-to-do/camping/ ('Campgrounds are closed from December 1 - March 31 (except to walk-in tent camping, which is allowed year-round).'), read 2026-11-03

values.note: Most sites must be reserved; the maps highlight the reservable ones and the rest are first come (set up, then register). No more than 14 days in any 17-day period. Cancellation by phone at least 7 days out for a partial refund; $10 change fee.

booking.source: https://www.polkcountyiowa.gov/conservation/things-to-do/camping/ ('Advance reservations are required at most campsites. Some of the sites are offered as first-come, first-served.'; 'Online reservations can be made up to one year in advance'; 'Maximum length of stay is 14 days') + mycountyparks Camping Reservation Contract ('more than 14 days out of any 17-day period'), read 2026-11-03

note: Polk County Conservation Board park on the W shore of Saylorville Lake. Campgrounds 1 and 2 are wooded with no water near; campground 4's east row faces an open field running down to the lake, and the non-electric campground 6 sits on a bench above the lake's eroded bank. Hike-in tent and youth areas too. --Claude
summary: Rate $25 electric (non-electric $20 small units/tents), 50 amp, 78 electric sites (was 142 from note), pull-through cleared, showers/dump/hydrants, season Apr 1-Nov 30, reservable 1 year out with some FCFS, 14-night max. FLAGS: waterfront lead not waterfront -> lakeview; phone.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD: stored not waterfront -> LAKEVIEW. The stored note's 'Loops sit on wooded hills set back from the lake behind a treeline' fits campgrounds 1 and 2 only, and there is no waterfront_evidence. Campground 4's east row (map sites ~403-414, electric) faces an open, unscreened field that slopes NE to Saylorville Lake: about 140 m from the pads to the water's edge on Esri imagery at 41.78596,-93.77433 (Overpass down, imagery estimate), so a view, not access (over the ~50 m bound). Campground 6 (non-electric, small units/tents) is a gravel loop on a grassy bench with its north sites ~40-60 m from the top of a treed, eroded bank that drops ~40 m more to the water: bluff/bench, lakeview at best. No on-water candidates.

PHONE: stored 515-323-5366 appears on none of the county's pages. The reservation contract says 'Park staff can be contacted at: Jester Park - (515) 249-3229' (also the park page's 'Ranger Cell Phone Number'); reservations and changes go through the Conservation office (515) 323-5300. Suggest 515-249-3229. apply.py doesn't write phone.

SITES: the non-electric sites in campgrounds 5 and 6 are marked 'SMALL UNITS / TENTS' on the county's maps, so whether a 23-ft motorhome fits them is unclear; the base fee is the $25 electric rate. Pin 41.7878,-93.7790 sits at the NE tip of campground 1, ~165 m from the centre of the loops; fine.
